info.title: OCC Integration Protocol
info.description: All paths are relative to OCC_BASE_PATH/api/v1. Project tokens are limited to their own project. Session writes also require CSRF and exact Origin. No remote execution or arbitrary webhooks.

get.summary: Minimal public liveness and database check

post.summary: Login; requires exact public Origin, rate limit 5/minute
Administrator approves and registers a manifest; never executes it
Issue a scoped project token, returned once
Explicit approval of a declared cached read-only operation
Invoke the shared permission-checked command registry
Confirm the exact administrator-approved manifest; scope project:read
Publish declared namespaced event; scope events:write

get.summary: Poll up to 100 own subscribed events; scope events:read
List own approved/pending operations; scope project:read

post.summary: Invoke an approved cached read; scope operations:invoke
Isolated transport ingress; platform-specific bearer credential, live mode only

get.summary: Recognized command names from the shared registry; no handlers or private content

post.summary: Ephemeral classified transport heartbeat, no conversation data
